assets.prompt: Create one original female classmate portrait for GRIMOIRE. REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 (short bob girl with burgundy scarf) supplies her DISTINCT appearance/silhouette and schoolgirl demeanor. Image 2 (boy with teal cape) supplies ONLY refined thin linework, precise anime shading, rendering quality; NEVER copy his face, fluffy hairstyle, head tilt or costume layout. Upgrade the girl to the same premium anime RPG illustration finish. Waist-up, upright head, looking slightly left, pale gray-green eyes with rounded almond contours, soft oval face and gently rounded chin, small closed mouth warm smile. Smooth chin-length blue-black BOB with a clean curved hem, short straight eyebrow-length bangs with a small side opening, tucked behind one ear. NOT fluffy spiky shag hairstyle. Youthful 16-17-year-old female peer, not adult glamour. Navy tailored school jacket with brass piping, white shirt, BURGUNDY SCARF softly wrapped at neck, NO high teal cape collar. Slim workbook tucked under left arm near waist, right hand loosely grasping the workbook lower edge, pose different from boy. Elegant controlled anime painting with beautifully finished eyes/hair/fabric, not Western comic, no rough watercolor. Single upperbody on plain pale blue-gray opaque background. Pull camera BACK: whole silhouette from head to waist with 10 percent empty margin on top and both sides. All shoulders/elbows visible, arms not clipped. No legs, no text, UI, magic, hat, staff, cleavage or watermark. This is a different person, not the boy with changed scarf.
